item.description: ### Fixed - **Codex "finished" notifications say what it did again.** Newer versions of Codex write their closing message somewhere Perch wasn't looking, so every Codex notification just said "Codex finished its turn." It now shows the first line of the reply, as it does for Claude Code. - **Hitting your Codex usage limit is reported as a limit, not a finish.** A Codex turn that stopped because you ran out of usage was announced as "finished". It now shows "Rate limited" and sends the rate-limit alert instead. A turn that stops on another error names the problem on the row.
